subject.title: Durable Core PR 4/6: persist agent-turn front doors

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed opt-in `durable` core contract—persistent intake evidence, authority-mode startup/fallback behavior, and a recovery worker—as a supported product surface?
rationale: This is a large new runtime, configuration, persistence, and recovery contract; code review cannot determine whether its operational cost and long-term ownership belong in core.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed durable core
options.body: Approve the opt-in durable contract in principle, require the two streaming admission repairs and focused upgrade/protocol proof before merge.

options.title: Defer the core contract
options.body: Pause this stack until maintainers define a smaller supported owner boundary or decide the capability belongs outside the present core roadmap.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed durable core
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in durable contract in principle, require the two streaming admission repairs and focused upgrade/protocol proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this contributor as the author of the proposed durable stack, although a current-main owner should be added by maintainers before accepting the product direction.
